mapper.select: select se.id as seasonId, se.display_title as seasonTitle, s.series_code as seriesCode, s.series_name as seriesName, d.id as divisionId, d.division_name as divisionName, d.platform_code as platformCode, d.platform_code as platformName, d.game_mode as gameMode, d.game_mode as gameModeName, d.registration_mode as registrationMode, et.id as eventTeamId, et.team_name_snapshot as eventTeamName, et.team_name_snapshot as teamName, et.team_logo_file_id as teamLogoFileId, case when ep.is_captain = 1 then 'CAPTAIN' else 'PLAYER' end as roleInTeam, et.event_team_status as eventTeamStatus, d.division_status as divisionStatus, cs.id as currentStageId, cs.stage_name as currentStageName, cs.stage_type as stageType, cs.execution_status as stageExecutionStatus, st.group_scope_key as currentGroupId, dg.group_name as currentGroupName, st.rank_no as standingRank, st.standing_points as standingPoints, q.qualification_status as qualificationStatus, q.qualification_status as qualificationStatusName, (select m.id from basket_match m left join basket_match_series ms on ms.id = m.series_id and ms.is_delete = 0 where m.is_delete = 0 and m.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' and m.match_status not in ('FINISHED', 'CANCELLED', 'FORFEITED') and (m.home_event_team_id = et.id or m.away_event_team_id = et.id) order by coalesce(m.match_time, case when ms.scheduled_date is not null and ms.scheduled_start_time is not null then timestamp(ms.scheduled_date, ms.scheduled_start_time) else null end) asc, m.id asc limit 1) as nextMatchId, (select coalesce(m.match_time, case when ms.scheduled_date is not null and ms.scheduled_start_time is not null then timestamp(ms.scheduled_date, ms.scheduled_start_time) else null end) from basket_match m left join basket_match_series ms on ms.id = m.series_id and ms.is_delete = 0 where m.is_delete = 0 and m.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' and m.match_status not in ('FINISHED', 'CANCELLED', 'FORFEITED') and (m.home_event_team_id = et.id or m.away_event_team_id = et.id) order by coalesce(m.match_time, case when ms.scheduled_date is not null and ms.scheduled_start_time is not null then timestamp(ms.scheduled_date, ms.scheduled_start_time) else null end) asc, m.id asc limit 1) as nextMatchTime, (select m.id from basket_match m where m.is_delete = 0 and m.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' and m.match_status in ('FINISHED', 'FORFEITED') and (m.home_event_team_id = et.id or m.away_event_team_id = et.id) order by m.match_time desc, m.id desc limit 1) as latestMatchId, (select concat(m.home_score, ':', m.away_score) from basket_match m where m.is_delete = 0 and m.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' and m.match_status in ('FINISHED', 'FORFEITED') and (m.home_event_team_id = et.id or m.away_event_team_id = et.id) order by m.match_time desc, m.id desc limit 1) as latestMatchResult, case when d.format_snapshot_id is null then 1 else 0 end as legacyEvent, (select count(1) from basket_match m where m.is_delete = 0 and m.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' and (m.home_event_team_id = et.id or m.away_event_team_id = et.id)) as matchCount, (select count(1) from basket_match m where m.is_delete = 0 and m.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' and m.match_status = 'FINISHED' and (m.home_event_team_id = et.id or m.away_event_team_id = et.id)) as finishedMatchCount, (select count(1) from basket_match m left join ( select s1.match_id, s1.submit_event_team_id, s1.submission_status from basket_match_submission s1 join ( select match_id, submit_event_team_id, max(version_no) as max_ver from basket_match_submission where is_delete = 0 group by match_id, submit_event_team_id ) lv on lv.match_id = s1.match_id and lv.submit_event_team_id = s1.submit_event_team_id and lv.max_ver = s1.version_no where s1.is_delete = 0 ) ps on ps.match_id = m.id and ps.submit_event_team_id = et.id where m.is_delete = 0 and m.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' and m.match_status in ('FINISHED', 'FORFEITED') and (m.home_event_team_id = et.id or m.away_event_team_id = et.id) and (ps.submission_status is null or ps.submission_status in ('DRAFT', 'REJECTED')) ) as pendingSubmissionCount from basket_event_player ep inner join basket_event_team et on et.id = ep.event_team_id and et.is_delete = 0 inner join basket_division d on d.id = et.division_id and d.is_delete = 0 inner join basket_season se on se.id = et.season_id and se.is_delete = 0 inner join basket_series s on s.id = se.series_id and s.is_delete = 0 left join basket_division_stage cs on cs.id = ( select ds.id from basket_division_stage ds where ds.division_id = d.id and ds.is_delete = 0 and ds.execution_status in ('RUNNING', 'RESULT_PENDING_CONFIRM', 'COMPLETED') order by ds.stage_order desc, ds.id desc limit 1 ) left join basket_standing st on st.is_delete = 0 and st.stage_id = cs.id and st.event_team_id = et.id and st.id = ( select st2.id from basket_standing st2 where st2.is_delete = 0 and st2.stage_id = cs.id and st2.event_team_id = et.id order by coalesce(st2.group_scope_key, 0) asc, st2.id asc limit 1 ) left join basket_division_group dg on dg.id = st.group_scope_key and dg.is_delete = 0 and st.group_scope_key > 0 left join basket_division_stage_qualification q on q.id = ( select q2.id from basket_division_stage_qualification q2 where q2.is_delete = 0 and q2.stage_id = cs.id and q2.event_team_id = et.id and q2.qualification_status in ('PREVIEW', 'CONFIRMED') order by case q2.qualification_status when 'CONFIRMED' then 0 else 1 end, q2.id desc limit 1 ) where ep.is_delete = 0 and (ep.member_id = #{memberId} or ep.source_player_id = #{playerId}) order by se.id desc, d.sort_order asc, et.id desc
